headline: A 2022 Senate budget plan for fiscal year 2023 that did not get a vote to advance, so it did not take effect.
what_it_does: This concurrent resolution would have set the federal government's overall budget plan for fiscal year 2023. It would also have set budget target levels for fiscal years 2024 through 2032. A budget resolution like this would have guided later spending and tax bills rather than creating specific programs or rules on its own. The official summary gives no further details, so this explanation is limited.
